|game_text=Deploy on opponent's just deployed [Reflections 3][Maintenance] card; opponent loses 1 Force, and you may retrieve 1 Force and/or play a Defensive Shield from under your Starting Effect. That [Maintenance] card is power -3, may not apply its ability towards drawing battle destiny, and, during opponent's draw phase, opponent must lose 1 Force or place that card in Lost Pile. If just lost, place this card in Used Pile. Immune to [[Honor Of The Jedi]]. (Immune to [[Control]].) OR If you are about to lose Force during opponent's control phase, deploy on table to reduce loss by 2.

|errata_history=This is the original printed title, “He Is Not Ready & Imperial Propaganda” (Bill, 10 November 2026: the “&” title is the original and the short title an errata of June 2013). The image is the release-sheet slip. The later version is [[He Is Not Ready (V)]] (PC-E1, the current card).
* '''Original''' (this page): the Virtual Block 4 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009), slip 25E, prints the card as “He Is Not Ready & Imperial Propaganda”<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock4">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Virtual Block 4 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"; the surviving copy was re-made 20 April 2010). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095223/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock4.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>. The Players Committee card image and every capture of the PC website card list up to 30 May 2013 also carry this title. The release-sheet slip ([[:File:VB4-25E-He_Is_Not_Ready.png]]) prints this text.
* '''PC-E1''' ([[He Is Not Ready (V)]]): on 14 June 2013 the Players Committee rules forum announced: “He Is Not Ready & Imperial Propaganda has been errataed and renamed He Is Not Ready (V). Its gametext remains unchanged.”<ref name="pcforum-p813434">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574, now titled “Current Rulings Archive August 2012 - December 2015”), post by Lukes Bionic Hand, 14 June 2013 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=20#p813434 forum post])</ref> The Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013, Dark Side, p. 26; the PDF was built in February 2014, after this errata) prints the card as “He Is Not Ready (V)” with the same game text<ref name="ml-ds">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_DS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Dark Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170704232650/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterDS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> ([[:File:VL-history-1240-26-front-master.png]]).

'''Another wording''' (not yet placed): The Players Committee's own Holotable card data of 29 May 2010 already has the other wording (“Target is power -3 …”, the card-list text) under the title “He Is Not Ready & Imperial Propaganda”, stamped “(Errata Text - March 18th, 2009)”<ref name="cdf-20100529-dark">Players Committee Holotable card data file, “version 20100529” (darkside.cdf; card data, not a printed source), as committed on 13 July 2010 to [https://github.com/ledwards/swccgvkit/blob/5047de0/db/darkside.cdf ledwards/swccgvkit] (commit 5047de0)</ref>; with the card list's stamp “Errata text - March 18, 2010” this dates that wording to an errata of 18 March 2010 (He Is Not Ready's “2009” is almost certainly a slip, since Block 4 first came out in December 2009). Which of the two wordings came first is still open (the first printing, of December 2009, is lost); the release-sheet slip and the Master List slip print the wording shown here.
